_README: Sanctions consolidated lists watched by scripts/sanctions-watch.mjs. Sibling to the FATF Watchdog (which watches country black/grey lists) and Regulatory Watch (which watches regulations/guidance). This watcher fingerprints the machine-readable designation lists and flags when designations change, feeding the sanctions answers, escalation/CFA logic and risk data. Each source: id, name, jurisdiction, url, type (csv|xml), optional marker (a substring counted once per record to report an approximate entry-count delta).
